title: Broaden the 5.5 adaptability guidance beyond AI
requirements:
- Add data portability, versioning, governed semantics and trust to interface flexibility
- Provide a reusable assessment method for technologies not discussed explicitly
- Add short considerations for genomics, remote monitoring and decentralised identity, or state they need future guidance
- Assign ownership and recurrent financing for continuous evolution
- Describe stage gates from problem definition through evaluation to scale
